interpretation.outerMeasuredTerms: Uses separately quantized captured P/T/W. Its residual against C is retained.
interpretation.sourceRootTerms: Reconstructs moisture/dry from measured roots and groups shared fertile palette/moisture/dry/weight paths. Mineral remains the measured mineralExposure root; no unseen raw slope attribution.
interpretation.sourceModelMinusObserved: Contains quantization and reconstruction residual; not a hidden attribution term.
interpretation.dominance: Conservative per-channel signed-mean bounds, not visual significance. Cancellation or overlapping intervals => MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE.
interpretation.footprints: Resolution proxies only; no aliasing proof.
interpretation.acceptance: No repair, visual success, device acceptance, or publication claim.
